answers.core: This is a usability enhancement that should improve the general workflow of users who do lots of iterative builds, for example while working on networking projects, such a feature can be implemented with an add-on, but I think this will hurt the said feature as it would not be as widely known of and will force the user to either find a working add-on or implement a similar feature themselves which can be tedious.
answers.workaround: If this enhancement is not desired, it could be easily switched off in the editor settings, Implementing a similar feature in a script can be a hassle.
